high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues of the sky and the position of the sun near the horizon. The sky is filled with a mix of fluffy white clouds and darker, more ominous clouds, creating a dramatic contrast. The sun is partially obscured by these clouds, casting a soft, golden light that illuminates parts of the sky and the water below. In the foreground, there is a rocky shoreline where a few people can be seen sitting and standing, seemingly enjoying the view or engaging in conversation.
